static_traits.name: Lin Yao
static_traits.family_status: Father is a dentist, Mother is a Teacher
static_traits.social_status: Has a supportive partner and close relationships with family; but at work keeps a distance from colleagues because of self-criticism
static_traits.medical_history: No significant physical illness; have not received psychotherapy before; no similar problems before
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, coherent logic, Good cooperativeness, marked self-reproach; Low mood but able to describe own experiences specifically

basic_info.main_problem: I have always felt I am the worst instructor when working at the daycare; this feeling started when I forgot to bring the movie for the kids, which made them very unhappy.
basic_info.core_demands: Events at work made me realize I am excessively self-critical, so I sought counseling to deal with these feelings.

core_beliefs: I am not competent enough / the worst instructor

special_situations.event: Forgetting to bring the movie for the kids at the daycare, making them unhappy
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I make a mistake at Work, it means I am incompetent and should not be an instructor
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Arranges other activities to make up for it and reduce disappointment
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am the worst instructor; I have let everyone down

special_situations.event: Making any small mistake at work
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I make a small mistake, it means I can do nothing well at Work
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Constantly self-scrutinizing and reproaching to avoid making mistakes again
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am too terrible; I should not be doing this Work at all

special_situations.event: When getting along with or needing to collaborate with colleagues
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If colleagues see my mistakes, they will think I am incompetent and look down on me
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Keeping distance from coworkers, reducing interaction to avoid exposing incompetence
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They will see how incompetent I am

special_situations.event: Reviewing work performance after organizing a successful event
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Only being completely error-free counts as qualified; good performance does not count
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Ignoring positive feedback, focusing only on mistakes
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Those good moments cannot change the fact that I am not good enough

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be recognized as competent and accepted by children and colleagues
core_conflict.fear: Fearing being seen as incompetent, disappointing others, and being judged or distanced
defense_goal: Prevents failure and external blame through strict self-demands and self-criticism
Keeps distance from colleagues to reduce the risk of being seen through and judged

object_relations.object_representation: Children easily hurt by my mistakes and disappointed

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When in counseling discussing interactions with colleagues or being invited to examine others' real views
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Subconsciously interpreting others' reactions as judgments of my incompetence (transference: Projection)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: In a gentle, inquiring tone, invites examples and evidence to distinguish speculation from fact; avoids judgment, gradually verifying others' actual feedback.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When discussing own mistakes or being pointed out for positive performance
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Internalizes negative emotions and external expectations into fierce accusations against the self, believing 'I have disappointed everyone'
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Empathizing with their guilt and shame, labeling emotions in supportive language; Guiding them to distinguish behavior from worth, encouraging specifying mistakes and correction plans, reducing blanket self-blame.

manifestations: Keeping distance from coworkers at Work, worrying about being seen as incompetent
Feeling embarrassed around partner and family, unwilling to share troubles, fearing burdening others
outcomes: Reduced social support and increased sense of isolation
Work stress and Low mood worsening

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'owning'
manifestations: Believing colleagues will see and judge my incompetence
Worrying others will look down on me for it

contact_model.definition: The individual has excessive self-reflection and self-restriction, being overly cautious, corresponding to 'autonomy'
manifestations: Frequent self-labeling and self-blame; hard to accept ordinary mistakes
Withdrawing in social situations to avoid exposing inadequacy

exception_events.target_problem: When making mistakes at work or recalling mistakes, the client usually sticks on the label 'I am the worst mentor', ignores positive performance, and becomes distant from colleagues.
exception_events.unique_outcome: When she once successfully organized a fun activity, the kids had a great time and gave positive feedback; she did not fall into the 'worst conclusion' but focused on executing the activity and the children's feedback, experiencing a sense of competence.
exception_events.reason: Clues: different approach - preparing in advance and refining the activity flow; different understanding - seeing a small oversight as an ordinary human mistake rather than a total negation of ability; different support - seeing the children's positive reactions in real time, forming positive evidence.

positive_force: Has a supportive partner and Good family relationships
Has the ability to organize fun activities and has received positive feedback from children
Willing to seek help and has begun attempts at reality testing and recording achievements
Continually learning (studying for a business administration degree), with growth motivation
negative_force: Labeling, overgeneralization, personalization and other cognitive biases marked, prone to catastrophizing and negating positive evidence
Excessive self-criticism, self-worth dependent on mistakes and others' evaluations
Keeps distance from colleagues, reduces social support
Strong shame and guilt, hard to express distress to partner and family

target_behavior.behavior: Self-labeling and blanket negation at Work ('I am the worst instructor')
antecedent: Making mistakes while working at the nursery (such as forgetting to bring the movie)
Reviewing and thinking about one's small mistakes
target_behavior.core_reason: Overgeneralizing a single mistake as inadequate ability, strong responsibility and fear of disappointing others driving Self-denial
target_behavior.function: Using self-criticism to 'prevent' future mistakes and gain a sense of control, while escaping Anxiety about being judged by others
target_behavior.consequence: Work performance and Damaged confidence, Low mood, Daily life affected

target_behavior.behavior: Social avoidance and keeping distance from colleagues
antecedent: When needing to collaborate or communicate with colleagues
Worrying colleagues will see one's mistakes
target_behavior.core_reason: Worrying about being judged as incompetent, internalizing others' possible views as threats
target_behavior.function: Escaping judgment and embarrassment, briefly reducing Anxiety
target_behavior.consequence: Relationship estrangement with colleagues, Reduced social support, rising stress

antecedent: After successfully completing tasks or receiving positive feedback, reviews work performance
target_behavior.core_reason: Rigid standards of 'must be error-free to qualify' and excessive Self-monitoring
target_behavior.function: Maintains high standards of self-demands to avoid being blamed
target_behavior.consequence: Declining Self-efficacy, positive experiences weakened, Low mood worsening
